page.content:
The men's world championship — hosts, heroes, and the trophy lifted every four years.

How FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Jules Rimet — Jules Rimet drove FIFA to stage the first World Cup in 1930.
  • Faction: FIFA — FIFA organizes the World Cup every four years.
  • Event: 1930 FIFA World Cup — The 1930 tournament was the first FIFA World Cup.
  • Item: FIFA World Cup Trophy — The FIFA World Cup Trophy is the prize of the modern tournament.
  • Event: 1958 FIFA World Cup — The 1958 tournament is Pelé's first World Cup chapter.
  • Event: 1986 FIFA World Cup — The 1986 tournament is Maradona's World Cup.
  • Event: 2022 FIFA World Cup — The 2022 tournament is Messi's World Cup.
  • Faction: Brazil national team — Brazil is the World Cup's most titled national team.
  • Event: 1970 FIFA World Cup — The 1970 tournament is Brazil's crowning World Cup side.
  • Faction: Argentina national team — Argentina's World Cup story is Maradona then Messi.
  • Event: 1998 FIFA World Cup — The 1998 tournament is Zidane's home World Cup.
  • Event: 2014 FIFA World Cup — The 2014 tournament is Germany's Rio World Cup.
  • Faction: Uruguay national team — Uruguay is the first World Cup champion.

What is FIFA World Cup?

The FIFA World Cup is the quadrennial tournament FIFA first staged in 1930. Its lore runs through Uruguay, Pelé's Brazil, Maradona in Mexico, Zidane in France, Germany 2014, Messi's 2022, and the two trophies — Jules Rimet and the current FIFA World Cup Trophy.

Key threads lead to Jules Rimet, FIFA, 1930 FIFA World Cup, FIFA World Cup Trophy, 1958 FIFA World Cup and 1986 FIFA World Cup.
